sources.entry: OpenOlitor - Administration platform for Community Supported Agriculture groups. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Scala

summary.one_liner: Server backend for OpenOlitor, an administration platform for Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) groups.
summary.what_it_does: This repository holds the server-side backend of the OpenOlitor administration platform, as described in its README (written in German). The README points to the main OpenOlitor project wiki for all documentation and says issues should be reported to the main project. It includes a bumpversion.sh script that increments the version in project/Build.scala and can optionally create a git commit and tag, or print the needed git commands. The README does not describe the specific administration features (members, subscriptions, deliveries and so on) beyond the general description of a CSA administration platform. A development setup section exists but is empty in the README.
use_cases: administering a community supported agriculture group
managing CSA member and subscription data
backend for the OpenOlitor web platform
versioning and tagging releases of the OpenOlitor server
how_to_run: ./bumpversion.sh -c -v 1.0.x (bumps version and creates a git commit and tag)
notable: Backend for the OpenOlitor CSA administration platform
Documentation and release notes live in the main OpenOlitor project wiki
bumpversion.sh script can create a git commit and tag for a new version
Code published under GPL v3 until April 2018, AGPL v3 afterwards
caveats: README is brief; development setup section is empty and docs are external in the project wiki
Issues are directed to the main OpenOlitor project rather than this repository
